analogy.rationale: PPAR antagonists act on PPARG/PPARD, nuclear receptors with limited expression in these cell lines, so they should produce little transcriptional response; the closest reference classes are other nuclear receptor ligands, especially PPAR agonists, which share the same receptors and cofactors but opposite direction.
